key_messaging.what_we_are: K1 is the trusted evidence-to-money infrastructure layer for construction and critical infrastructure.
key_messaging.what_we_do: We turn field events into financial-grade truth — validated evidence that can drive workflow, compliance, risk, and payment actions.
key_messaging.why_it_matters: Construction and critical infrastructure currently rely on unverifiable field reporting to authorize huge sums of money. K1 closes that gap.
key_messaging.why_ip_matters: 16 clean utility nonprovisionals plus 17 provisionals create a defensible category position spanning platform, evidence, verticals, and finance.
key_messaging.why_finance_and_payments_matter: Six of the 16 filings sit directly in the financial stack — lending, receivables, fraud, credit, escrow, lien waiver, retainage, milestone billing, forecasting, and tokenized rights. This is where the value is captured.
key_messaging.why_tokenized_rights_matter: Tokenized, evidence-backed construction payment rights make construction receivables programmable, transferable, and financeable on rails — unlocking new credit and liquidity products.
